name: Dual on-chain confirmation — active-address AND tx_count both cross up to gate a momentum BTC long
rationale: Thesis: demand confirmation is stronger when BOTH the breadth of usage (distinct active addresses) AND the depth (total transactions) accelerate together — twin cross_ups reduce the chance either is a one-off artifact (dust spam inflates tx_count; exchange-reshuffles inflate addresses). Both series drift, so both enter ONLY as cross_ups. A modest positive-momentum gate ensures we ride a price trend the chain is corroborating. Disconfirmer 1: require only the active-address cross_up (drop the tx_count one) — if the deflated Sharpe is unchanged, the dual confirmation is overfit and a single cross carries everything. Disconfirmer 2: drop BOTH crosses and keep only ret_Nd>mom_floor — if the Sharpe holds, the on-chain layer is pure momentum dressing. BTC-only, long-only spot.
catalyst: btc_active_addresses AND btc_tx_count both cross up while BTC momentum is positive
